notes.title: Major Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Here at FungalWorks we are terminally silly geese. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585290/c1f2c439e84c7f921acee405ecf30fbd0f5f353a.gif[/img]

We accidentally flipped a variable which zooped the player past 1.5+ hrs of content straight to the ending scene. Oopsie doopse! We are a terribly silly fungus. That should be fixed!

Also in the works is a V1.1 major update which will eliminate soft locks and such. That is a bit of work so that's not today, but it is coming!

Hopefully now you can actually enjoy the FULL GAME without being locked out of the death parlour or skipped straight to the end. 

If we look at this positively, though, it's like I'm giving a whole DLC chapter for free and as a surprise! Hooray!

As always, thanks for playing!
